name: text-stats

options.name: --no-digits
options.description: leave out the words with a digit («2026», «15000», «A4») of every count, the words total included, as if the text did not hold them; chars and chars_no_spaces stay those of the text as given.

options.name: --exclude
options.description: words to leave out the same way, as written, with case and ё folded, not by lemma («года» does not leave out «год»). Items: a comma list 'a,b', @FILE (one item per line, or the first column of a table) or @NAME of a list.
